EXECUTIVE EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

Article 1. Position and Duties
Section 1.1 Principal Office and Responsibilities
Executive shall serve as Chief Technology Officer reporting exclusively to the Chief Executive Officer.

Article 2. Compensation and Benefits
Section 2.1 Base Salary
Employer shall pay Executive an annual base salary of $375,000 payable in semi-monthly installments.

Section 2.3 Severance Upon Termination Without Cause
If Executive is terminated without Cause, Employer shall pay twelve (12) months base salary continuation.

Article 3. Restrictive Covenants
Section 3.1 Non-Competition and Non-Solicitation
During the term and for one year thereafter, Executive shall not solicit employees or customers of Employer.
